name: Brazier Fire Colors
creator: etherroot
description:
A simple custom mod that changes the colors of the Rift’s brazier flames for a fresh and personalized look. Includes the original Ruined brazier fire, ported from the old Ultbook map mode the Ruined version of Summoner’s Rift.
